item.title: How Trump’s timeline for ending the Iran war keeps shifting
item.description: The president has repeatedly suggested that the conflict was nearing a conclusion while simultaneously escalating threats against Tehran.

item.title: Some House Democrats press Trump to break silence on Israel’s nuclear arsenal
item.description: A letter from 29 lawmakers calls on the U.S. to expose Israel’s weapons program, which it doesn’t acknowledge and was built in secret beginning in the late 1950s.
